items.oldText: I thought you were very brave to say that

items.text: I thought it was a mistake
items.knownText: o’n i’n meddwl fod o’n gamgymeriad
items.oldText: you thought that it was a mistake

items.text: I thought that it was broken
items.knownText: o’n i’n meddwl fod o wedi torri
items.oldText: I wouldn't have dared to tell her that it was broken

items.text: I knew that they had broken it
items.knownText: o’n i’n gwybod bo’ nhw wedi’i dorri fo
items.oldText: I knew that the children had broken it

items.text: I want a strong cup of coffee or tea
items.knownText: dw i isio panad cryf o goffi neu de
items.oldText: do you want a cup of coffee or tea?

items.text: it would be great
items.knownText: byddai’n fendigedig
items.oldText: yes, that would be great, please

items.text: your coffee is ready now
items.knownText: mae dy goffi di’n barod rŵan
items.oldText: your coffee is ready

items.text: without sugar but with milk
items.knownText: heb siwgr ond efo llefrith
items.oldText: I like it with milk but without sugar

items.text: a large glass of water
items.knownText: gwydrad mawr o ddŵr
items.oldText: a large glass of water would be fine

items.text: one of those
items.oldText: I'd like one of those

items.text: but that is Siân’s bag
items.knownText: ond bag Siân ydy hwnna
items.oldText: that is Siân's bag

items.text: I heard that that is Siân’s bag
items.knownText: clywes i mai bag Siân ydy hwnna
items.oldText: I think that that is Siân's bag

items.text: it’s the red one now
items.knownText: yr un coch ydy o rŵan
items.oldText: it's the red one

items.text: the red one on that chair
items.knownText: yr un coch ar y gadair yna
items.oldText: I think that it's the red one on that chair

items.text: to sit with you all
items.knownText: eistedd efo chi gyd
items.oldText: with you all

items.text: I hope you’ll all be able to
items.knownText: dw i’n gobeithio y byddwch chi gyd yn medru
items.oldText: I hope you'll all be able to go

items.text: he can build a new life
items.knownText: gall e adeiladu bywyd newydd
items.oldText: he can build a new life for his sister

items.text: the sensible thing to do would have been
items.knownText: y peth call i’w wneud fyddai wedi bod
items.oldText: the sensible thing to do would have been to ask

items.text: to look for work
items.oldText: he needs to look for work
